title: OpenAI Announces 20% Price Reduction for GPT-5.6 Sol Model
summary: OpenAI has introduced a 20% reduction in input pricing and a 33% reduction in output pricing for its GPT-5.6 Sol model, a frontier model designed for complex professional work. The new pricing is $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens, available at least through November 21, 2026. The model features a 1,050,000-token context window, supports reasoning efforts from none to max, and includes various endpoints and tools like web search, code interpreter, and hosted shell.
key_points: GPT-5.6 Sol is OpenAI's latest frontier model for complex professional tasks.
20% reduction in input token pricing ($4 per 1M tokens) and 33% reduction in output token pricing ($20 per 1M tokens).
Promotional pricing available until at least November 21, 2026.
1,050,000-token context window with support for up to 128,000 output tokens.
Supports reasoning efforts: none, low, medium (default), high, xhigh, and max.
Modalities: Text input/output, image input only; audio and video not supported.
Tools supported: Web search, file search, image generation, code interpreter, hosted shell, apply patch, computer use, MCP, and tool search.
Rate limits vary by usage tier, with automatic increases as usage grows.
Snapshots available for consistent model performance and behavior.
